title: Fix ParameterBindingException: -LiteralPath not supported in Windows PowerShell 5.1
body:
`New-Item` and `Export-Csv` don't support `-LiteralPath` in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (added in PS 6.0), causing a `ParameterBindingException` when creating the output directory or any per-form subdirectory, and when writing the CSV index.

## Changes
- **`New-Item -LiteralPath` → `-Path`** for both the root `$OutputPath` and per-form `$formFolder` directory creation
- **`Export-Csv -LiteralPath` → `-Path`** for the per-form `_submissions_index.csv` write

All other `-LiteralPath` usages (`Test-Path`, `Get-Item`, `Remove-Item`, `Move-Item`) are supported in PS 5.1 and are unchanged.
